concept_definition: The quality of being important, valuable, or deserving attention.
A favorable condition or benefit that makes success more likely or gives someone or something an improved position.
A popular style of clothing, hair, behavior, or appearance at a particular time.
The great size, extent, importance, or effect of something.
The quality or degree of being physically hard and resistant to scratching, cutting, denting, or deformation.
How well a person, machine, system, or organization functions or achieves a result.
The perceived highness or lowness of a sound.
The qualities, abilities, or behavior associated with effectively leading people.
The general opinion or judgment that people have about someone or something, especially concerning their character, abilities, or quality.
The ability to achieve a desired result with the least waste of time, effort, energy, or resources.
The quality of performing a task or operating in an organized way without unnecessary delay or waste.
The ability to make sensible, careful decisions, especially by avoiding unnecessary risks or revealing private information.
The distinctive quality or character of a sound, especially a musical sound, that distinguishes it from other sounds of the same pitch and loudness.
The quality or state of being functional; the ability of a thing to perform its intended purpose effectively.
The ability of an object, material, or product to remain usable and resist damage, wear, or deterioration over a long period.
The quality or degree of giving off or reflecting light; brightness.
The quality of being fair, sensible, and guided by sound judgment.
The quality of treating people equally and reasonably, without favoritism or discrimination.
The quality or state of being dangerous; the degree to which someone or something is likely to cause harm, injury, or death.
A level of quality or achievement used as a measure or comparison.
A way in which two or more people or things are not the same.
The way someone or something looks, especially its outward visual qualities.
A person’s overall sense of their own worth or value.
The state of being superior to all others in importance, rank, quality, or achievement; supremacy.
In sports, home advantage is the benefit a team or athlete may gain by competing at their usual home venue rather than away, often because of familiar surroundings and support from local fans.
An athlete’s personal best is the highest performance they have achieved in a particular event or discipline.
Fair and respectful behavior toward opponents, officials, and teammates in sports, whether winning or losing.
The power or ability to affect how someone thinks, behaves, or makes decisions, or how something develops.
The quality or practice of favoring practical usefulness and effectiveness over beauty, tradition, or other ideals.
The state of having high social or official status that brings influence or prestige.
The quality of being true or accurate (the truth of a statement).
notes: Split from N17_028 (subtype review gestalt); translations needed.

concept_definition: Severity is the quality of being harsh, intense, or difficult to endure.
The ability to control different parts of the body or movements so that they work together smoothly.
A vehicle’s ability to gain speed, especially over a specified interval.
The quality of being rigid and resistant to bending, movement, or change in shape.
The careful and efficient use of money, time, materials, or other resources.
The quality of being lively, energetic, and expressive.
A characteristic style or form of buildings, especially one associated with a particular period, place, or designer.
A quality of an event, presentation, or situation that makes it feel emotionally intense or theatrical.
Poetic quality is beauty, imagination, or emotional expressiveness found in language, art, actions, or experiences.
The degree to which musical notes are accurately tuned and in tune.
The quality of having well-developed character, judgment, or emotional behavior.
A pale purple color resembling the flowers of the lavender plant.
The tendency of customers to keep choosing and buying from a particular brand, store, product, or service.
Prestige is the respect and high standing a person or organization enjoys because of its achievements or conduct.
A feature or event that provides evidence of a condition or trend.
The capacity of a substance, force, or signal to enter or pass through a material, barrier, or area.
The ability to understand the true nature of people or situations quickly and accurately.
The quality of being attractive, interesting, or pleasing to someone.
The freedom or authority to decide what to do in a particular situation.

Respectful submission or yielding to another person’s wishes, judgment, or authority.
A reddish-brown color resembling baked terracotta clay.
A characteristic aesthetic approach in art, architecture, literature, or design that uses eclectic borrowing, self-reference, irony, fragmentation, and mixtures of historical and popular forms.
The occurrence of two distinct forms or structures within one species or biological population, especially differences between males and females.
Exceptional intellectual or spiritual insight, clarity, or excellence.
The quality of producing a strong emotional response or bringing feelings, memories, or associations to mind.
Viscosity is a fluid’s resistance to flowing, arising from its internal friction.
The ability or degree of a material to conduct electricity, heat, or another form of energy.
The quality of being moderate and not excessive, especially in cost, demands, or terms.
Self-confidence is belief in and trust in one's own abilities, qualities, and judgment.
A decorative or contrasting feature added to something to make it more visually interesting or noticeable.
The quality of conforming to the standard rules of a language.
The degree of clarity and detail in an image, sound, or outline.
A person or thing that is cherished or greatly valued.
A trace is a very small amount or slight indication of a quality, flavor, color, or other feature.
The degree to which an object, vehicle, or animal responds readily and predictably to being controlled or operated.
Excessive confidence or boldness in behaving or making claims, especially when it is unwarranted.
Resolve is the firm purpose and persistence to achieve something despite difficulties.
The ability of a substance to dissolve in a particular solvent, often measured as the maximum amount that dissolves under specified conditions.
Carelessness is a lack of sufficient attention or effort in doing something.
A person's makeup is the combination of qualities, abilities, and physical or psychological traits that characterize them.
An attribute is a quality or feature of a person or thing.
Nobility is a quality of noble or morally elevated character, especially generosity, dignity, or courage.
An apparent quality or state that something seems to have, which may not match reality.
A distinctive or important characteristic, quality, or part of something.
The power, skill, or competence to do something; the capacity to perform an action or achieve a result.
A natural or acquired talent or aptitude for a particular activity or field.
Reliance on one's own abilities and resources rather than on others.
A skill, education, or credential that shows someone is suitable for a particular job.
In employment, an ability to perform a task or activity well, often developed through training or experience.
The quality or degree of being acidic; the amount of acid present in a substance, especially as measured by pH.
A sour or sharp taste, especially one caused by acid in food or drink.
A deep, dark reddish-purple color resembling the skin of a plum.
The way a surface feels or appears to feel, especially whether it is smooth, rough, soft, or coarse.
The characteristic structure or consistency of a substance, especially food, considered in terms of how it feels in the mouth or how its parts are arranged.
The ability to move or be moved freely and easily, either physically or from place to place.
The ability or opportunity to move between different levels, positions, or circumstances within a society, organization, or system.
A set of principles or an overall style that shapes the appearance or atmosphere of something, especially art, design, or a person’s presentation.
The practice or quality of representing people, objects, or events accurately and without idealization.
A practical acceptance of facts and limitations, with decisions based on what is achievable rather than on hopes or ideals.
A quality or feature that makes someone or something pleasing, attractive, or likable.
The quality of being exceptionally good or outstanding; the state of surpassing ordinary standards.
A quality, feature, or instance of outstanding merit or superiority.
The quality of being suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose, role, or situation.
The quality or ability to perceive, express, or appreciate what is amusing; the capacity to make people laugh.
A measurement or evaluation of the quality, value, performance, or level of something, often expressed as a score or grade.
An official assessment of a person's rank, skill, or ability, especially in a competitive activity such as chess or a sport.
A quality of being attractive, mysterious, or exciting because of association with the past, distance, or adventure.
A person's usual emotional nature or characteristic way of reacting, especially how easily they become angry.
A person's characteristic emotional disposition, especially as it affects their behavior.
The quality or state of being warm; a comfortable or moderate degree of heat.
A friendly, affectionate, or enthusiastic quality in a person's manner or feelings.
A natural tendency of a substance or organism to combine with, bind to, or be attracted to another substance or structure.
The ability of something, such as a treatment, method, or action, to produce the intended or desired result; effectiveness.
A quality or state of being foolish; lack of good judgment.
A vivid, bright red color, often with a slightly orange tint.
The state or quality of being better, greater, or more advanced than someone or something else.
An attitude or manner that suggests one considers oneself better or more important than others.
The ability or willingness to accept or endure something different, unpleasant, or disagreeable without reacting negatively.
The power or capacity of a person or group to endure hardship, pain, or stress.
The quality or state of being transparent: allowing light to pass through so that objects can be seen clearly.
The courage and determination needed to face difficulty or opposition; strength of character.
The state or quality of being clean, especially being free from dirt, stains, or unwanted substances.
The quality or condition of being able to compete successfully, especially in business, trade, or sports.

The friendly, generous reception and treatment of guests or visitors.
The ability to think of clever, original ways to solve problems or make things; inventiveness.

A brown color in the skin caused by exposure to sunlight or another source of ultraviolet light.
A positive aspect or advantage of a situation, especially one that also has disadvantages.
The quality or state of being useful; the ability to serve a purpose or help achieve something.
The state of being strong, energetic, and full of life.
The quality of being lively, vigorous, and full of energy, especially in a person’s character, work, or artistic expression.
The quality or state of being white in color; the quality of reflecting most visible light and appearing light rather than dark.

The ability to do something successfully or effectively, especially because of having the necessary skill, knowledge, or experience.

The state or quality of being free from dirt, pollutants, or other unwanted substances.

The state or quality of being similar in appearance, nature, or characteristics to someone or something else.

The natural color and appearance of a person's skin, especially the face.

A particular color or shade, especially as distinguished by its name or position on the color spectrum.
The quality or state of being new, original, or different from what is usual; newness.
The force or effectiveness of an action, statement, or performance; impact.
The quality of being cultured, elegant, or sophisticated in manners, taste, or style.

The pleasant, gentle, or kind quality of a person, voice, sound, or manner.
A person's usual emotional nature and characteristic way of reacting, including their prevailing moods and disposition.
A person's characteristic balance or intensity of feelings, especially as it affects their behavior or suitability for a particular activity or role.

Physical or mental strength, energy, and enthusiasm.

An advantage, helpful effect, or good result.

Importance or significance; the quality of being consequential.
